register_task: register a new EmbodiedTask subclass to the Habitat registry using the register_task decorator
register_simulator: register a new Simulator subclass to the Habitat registry using the register_simulator decorator
register_sensor: register a new Sensor subclass to the Habitat registry using the register_sensor decorator
get_task: get a registered EmbodiedTask class by name from the Habitat registry using get_task
get_simulator: get a registered Simulator class by name from the Habitat registry using get_simulator
